headline: Gate E progressive independence (3-channel og-08-reuse, one-at-a-time — the per-feedstock split + temperature-as-Arrhenius is og-37a): verdict=qualified. Reusing og-08's VALIDATED co-limited off-gradient budget verbatim (no invented terms), each support channel is withdrawn ALONE where og-08 relaxed them jointly. With the full innovation set each of the 3 channels is internalizable (gradient surv 1.00, mineral 1.00, feed 1.00; all ≥ 0.5, budget margins +0.26/+0.26/+0.26 above the floor — transparent, not knife-edge), and the matched per-support ablation ATTRIBUTES each to its rescuing innovation (gradient→pump, mineral→importer, feed→importer: switching that innovation off collapses the lineage), which the og-08 all-at-once run cannot do (it escapes with the full set but fails if ANY innovation is removed, confound_shown=True). Heredity is the irreducible substrate — every channel also collapses with heredity off (heredity_substrate=True). The gradient channel is BUDGET-SENSITIVE: its internalization flips to a hard dependency below pump efficiency ~0.7 (internalizable only for catalyst_efficiency ≥ 0.7), grounded in study-35's limited internal surplus — so at a less efficient pump the pH/pmf drive is irreducible. Mineral and feed (importer) are robust. HONEST CAVEATS: feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics), so this does NOT resolve independence for those feedstocks individually; and the innovations are COARSE budget abstractions, so this is an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated real-cell escape. So qualified = a graded, attributed independence profile on the validated coarse budget, never a clean escape; the resolved per-feedstock chemistry + Arrhenius temperature + combinatorial multi-withdrawal is og-37a. Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
